title: TASE plan request
description: The request of `tase.code.plan` (design §2.3). The plan itself is not a file: it is the canonical JSON of this request, and its digest is the digest of that JSON.

contract_version.description: The version of the contract the caller speaks (1.0 or 1.1).

repository_id.description: The repository the plan works in.

target_ref.description: The ref the plan is built on, for example `refs/heads/agent-feature`.

base_commit.description: The commit the plan starts from.

strategy.description: The strategy of the plan: `template`, `semantic` or `freeform`.

operations.description: The operations of the plan, in the order they are applied.

validation_profile.description: The profile the plan is validated with.

approval_policy.description: The policy the plan is approved with.

identifier.description: An identifier of the contract: not empty, at most 128 characters, `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]` only.

op_id.description: The id of the operation inside its plan.

params.description: The parameters of the template. The order of the parameters is part of the digest of the plan.

path.description: The path of the file, relative to the root of the repository, with `/` as the separator.

symbol.description: The symbol the operation works on. For a new method it is the declaration that is written, not an anchor that exists.

digest.description: The digest of the template package the operation is pinned to.

file_blob_sha.description: The digest of the blob of the file. It is null for a file that does not exist yet.

symbol_signature_hash.description: The digest of the signature of the symbol.

expected_symbol_exists.description: Whether the symbol is expected to exist.
